headline: Latvia Reports Airspace Intrusion Near Russian and Belarusian Borders
summary: Latvia reported an unauthorized airspace intrusion near its eastern border shared with Russia and Belarus. The incident occurred near the Adazi military training site.
why: Latvia is a NATO and European Union member state situated on NATO's eastern flank bordering Russia and Belarus.

impacts.name: Latvia
impacts.why: Border security incidents elevate regional military risks along Europe's eastern NATO frontier.
